catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.description: The catalog: an Iceberg REST catalog, or AWS Glue.

uri.title: URI
uri.description: The REST catalog's URI, such as https://catalog.example.com/api/catalog.

warehouse.title: Warehouse
warehouse.description: The REST catalog's warehouse, as the catalog names it, or Glue's location for new tables, such as s3://bucket/prefix.

namespace.title: Namespace
namespace.description: The tables' namespace when the pipeline names none; levels joined by ".". Created if missing.

token.title: Bearer token
token.description: A bearer token the REST catalog takes. Set it or credential.

credential.title: OAuth2 client credentials
credential.description: OAuth2 client credentials, as client_id:client_secret, which the REST catalog exchanges for a token.

region.title: AWS region
region.description: The AWS region of Glue and S3. Without one, the AWS default.

accessKeyId.title: Access key ID
accessKeyId.description: An AWS access key for Glue and S3. Without one, the AWS default credentials.

s3Endpoint.title: S3 endpoint
s3Endpoint.description: An S3-compatible store's endpoint, for one other than AWS, with path-style addressing.

properties.title: Properties
properties.description: More catalog and file IO properties, as Iceberg names them, such as glue.endpoint, glue.id, s3.endpoint or a REST catalog's header.* and rest.* settings. A REST catalog's scope, oauth2-server-uri, audience, resource, rest.sigv4-enabled, rest.signing-name and rest.signing-region apply from its first request.

x-groups.title: Catalog
x-groups.description: Which catalog holds the tables, and where.

x-groups.title: REST catalog sign-in
x-groups.description: A bearer token or OAuth2 client credentials; a catalog that needs neither takes none.

x-groups.title: AWS and S3
x-groups.description: Glue's and the store's region and keys, and an S3-compatible endpoint.
